sampling: uniform without replacement within batch; replacement across batches
shared_parameters: two hidden Linear layers, excluding action-specific output layer

supervised.optimizer: fresh Adam, identical diagnostic LR for all network copies
supervised.role: local supervised capacity diagnostic; never a landing policy

interference.evaluation_set: fixed held-out terminal state-action groups, excluded from branch minibatches
interference.sampling: uniform from non-held-out replay; retain first 32 batches containing both groups
interference.group_loss: sum of active sample losses divided by FULL minibatch size, then original clipping and Adam; no group reweighting
interference.role: paired one-step probes, not a training campaign

protection: original files and weights immutable; no final-test evaluation; no beta=10 execution
